other_conflicting_accesses: L55 itself re-loads best_dist[thread_idx + i] (right-hand side) and L56 `best_dist_idx[thread_idx] = best_dist_idx[thread_idx + i];` loads best_dist_idx[thread_idx + i] and stores best_dist_idx[thread_idx] (int64_t array `best_dist_idx[THREADS]` at L21, st/ld.shared.u64): the same cross-thread WAR/torn-read pattern on the index array. In all, thread t performs three separate reads of slots t+i (L54, L55 for best_dist; L56 for best_dist_idx) that thread t + i may overwrite (L55, L56) in the same barrier interval, so the (value, index) pair read by thread t can be torn.
The pre-loop stores L48-L49 (`best_dist[thread_idx] = best; best_dist_idx[thread_idx] = best_idx;`) are ordered by the first barrier of the loop (L52) and do not race.
thread_pair_example: fps_kernel, block 0 (256 threads = 8 warps), reduction step i = 64: thread 0 (warp 0) reads best_dist[64] at L54 (and L55) while thread 64 (warp 2) evaluates `best_dist[64] < best_dist[128]` and writes best_dist[64] at L55 in the same barrier interval (the barrier is L52 of this i-step; the next is L52 of the i = 128 step). For i < 32 the same pair is intra-warp (e.g. i = 1: thread 0 reads best_dist[1], thread 1 writes best_dist[1]).
class_reason: Both accesses are plain (non-volatile, non-atomic) accesses to the shared array best_dist (verify.strong_accesses: none); within one barrier interval thread t reads the slot t + i that thread t + i may overwrite, with no ordering between the read and the write (the barrier at L52 only separates the i-steps). Plain vs plain unordered conflicting pair = DR under D20. The same in-place reduction shape was fixed upstream in nearest_cuda.cu (commit a5abfee).

upstream_status.dispute_points: Maintainer might argue that the max-reduction is monotone so reading a newer value is harmless; but value and index are copied by separate loads, so a torn pair is possible. Practically the tear needs thread t+i to commit its update between thread t's loads; real hardware would rarely show it. Also for i<32 the warp-lockstep assumption (pre-Volta) hides it. Disputable but formally a data race.
